zh: 直接在任务详情中回答问题，并从侧边栏切换待回答的问题。
手机上的问题输入框会在键盘弹出时保持可见。
从看板打开任务后会清除未读标记，避免任务重新出现在待查看列表。
en: Answer questions directly in task details and switch between pending questions from the sidebar.
On phones, question inputs stay visible when the keyboard opens.
Opening a task from the board clears its unread mark, preventing it from reappearing in the review lane.
